packs.description: 15 nodes for inventory menu replacements: key, equip, drop, item card and category events, select, drop, sound and 3D item actions.
37 math nodes: trigonometry, rounding, powers and logs, remap, wrap, easing, distance and random helpers.
29 array utilities: index of, get, slice, unique, sort, shuffle, sum, pluck and filter by field and more.
30 text utilities: trim, pad, truncate, search, split, format thousands, escape HTML and more.
